meta.purpose: Complete map of the Shokker Paint Booth UI for the helper (offline brain, Chat copilot, MCP clients) to reason with.

schema.id: stable key (DOM id, or <panel>.<slug>, or zone.* / layer.* / ai.* for JS-built controls)
schema.label: what the UI shows
schema.curated: false = auto-generated from the HTML tooltip only
schema.source: html | js:<where the control is built>

caveats: Fleet and Season batch controls are RETIRED (items with retired=true): hidden panel, nothing opens it, the handlers only show a disabled toast.
Pro zone editor / layer rows / AI panel are built by JavaScript: read from the live DOM on 2026-10-03 (test server) and curated by hand.
There is NO sort/group-by-colour in the Layers panel (Smart Separate was withdrawn); colour work is done via zone colour picking.

modes.label: PRO
modes.where: Top row > PRO / CHAT pill (left of SPEC SCULPT)
modes.does: The full paint shop: zones, finishes, layers, masks, spec tools, every slider. Everything else is a friendlier front door onto this.
modes.when: A buyer wants exact control, or something Chat cannot do (hand-drawn masks, spec sliders, layers, patterns).
modes.mistakes: New buyers feel lost here - point them at CHAT first, or at the Tutorial (Training Wheels).
modes.help_text: PRO - the full paint shop: every tool, layers, masks, zones, Spec Sculpt.

modes.label: CHAT
modes.does: Talk to Shokker in plain words ("make the hood matte black", "retro red white and blue stripes") and watch the car change. Works with no key; a key or Claude/ChatGPT makes it smarter.
modes.when: A buyer does not know which control to use, or just knows the look they want.
modes.mistakes: Chat cannot import files, export, or hand-paint. It changes zones and layer settings, and every change has an Undo button.
modes.help_text: CHAT - talk to Shokker: say what you want and watch your car change. Works without any key; an AI key makes it smarter.

panels.label: Header rows
panels.where: Pro > top of the window, first rows (iRacing User ID, Source Paint, iRacing Car Folder)
panels.does: Top of the window: iRacing User ID, Number type, Source Paint (TGA / PSD) and iRacing Car Folder. These decide WHAT is painted and WHERE the files go.

panels.label: PRO / CHAT pill
panels.where: Any mode > top row > PRO / CHAT pill
panels.does: Switches between the full shop and the talk-to-Shokker front door. The paint and zones carry across.

panels.label: Top toolbar
panels.does: Tool row (Move, Pick, Color, Wand, Lasso, Rect, Brush, Fill, Erase), the HISTORY / SELECT / RETOUCH / MASK / SPEC TOOLS / TRANSFORM / ADJUST menus, the ZONE / LAYER target switch, RENDER HISTORY, Save / Open and Import Recipe.

panels.label: Settings (gear)
panels.does: Licence key, Keyboard Shortcuts, ZIP export, Live Link / auto-deploy, imported spec map, Training Wheels, file picker style.

panels.label: ZONES (left column)
panels.does: The list of zones, top = highest priority. Each card shows what it covers. + Add Zone, Reset All Zones, More menu. Click a card to open its ZONE POPOUT PANEL.

panels.label: ZONES > More menu
panels.where: Pro > left column > ZONES > More (three-dot) menu
panels.does: Presets Gallery, randomise, Apply Finish to All, Shokker Library, Undo History, templates, SHOKK files, PNG channel export.

panels.label: ZONE POPOUT PANEL
panels.does: Where one zone is edited: COLOR (which pixels), APPLY AREA (box / lasso), BASE (finish + colour + strengths + spec sliders), SPEC OVERLAYS, PATTERN, OVERLAYS (2nd to 5th base).

panels.label: Centre column
panels.does: The paint (SOURCE) and the LIVE PREVIEW of the finished car, zoom buttons, the RENDER button and the spec channel strip.

panels.label: Tool options bar
panels.where: Pro > centre > tool options bar (changes with the active tool)
panels.does: Appears under the toolbar; its sliders change with the tool you picked (brush size, wand tolerance, text font ...).

panels.label: Selection / mask bar
panels.where: Pro > centre > selection / mask bar under the canvas
panels.does: Under the canvas: Include / Exclude brushes, Undo / Redo, Deselect, Invert, Grow / Shrink / Feather / Smooth, Copy / Mirror mask, Zoom to selection.

panels.label: Preview and spec channels
panels.where: Pro > centre > spec channel strip under the preview
panels.does: LIVE PREVIEW of the render plus COMBINED / R METAL / G ROUGH / B COAT views of the spec map.

panels.label: RENDER and recipe card
panels.does: RENDER makes the finished paint + spec TGAs; the recipe card afterwards offers Copy Card, Save Card PNG, Share Recipe, Copy TP Desc, Save to keep, Deploy.

panels.label: Right column
panels.does: Tabs: FINISHES (library) and LAYERS (PSD layers).

panels.label: LAYERS tab
panels.does: The layer list of a PSD / XCF / ORA: eye, name, opacity, blend, lock, ... plus Open Layered, + Layer, Actions, filter box.

panels.label: FINISHES library
panels.does: Full-screen browser of the whole catalogue (about 4,800 looks) with search, filters and favourites.

panels.label: Base Material picker
panels.where: Pro > zone editor > Base Material picker (popup)
panels.does: Popup opened from a zone BASE section: search, #hashtag chips (#carbon, #chrome ...), On-Car Stage, Surprise me, See on paint, Color Lock.

panels.label: Spec Tools
panels.does: Decal Rescue Kit, Lighting Mask, Material Sampler (read M/R/CC of any pixel), Range Remapper. For spec-map fixing.

panels.label: Dialogs
panels.does: Small windows: file browser, dual colour-shift, script export.

panels.label: Undo History
panels.does: List of recent actions with Undo / Redo / Clear.

panels.label: SHOKK files
panels.where: Pro > ZONES > More > LOAD SHOKK FILE
panels.does: Save or load a whole session (zones + finishes, optionally the paint) as a .shokk file.

panels.label: Shokker AI panel
panels.does: The "AI" button (bottom right) opens the copilot: type what you want, it changes zones; each answer has Undo. Gear = key, model, Claude / ChatGPT connection.

panels.label: Chat mode
panels.does: Pro screen plus the AI copilot opened for talking; same zones, same Undo.

items.label: Download Update
items.where: Pro > banner under the title bar (update available)
items.does: Downloads the new Shokker version.
items.when: The update banner shows.
items.mistakes: Save your project first; installing restarts the app.

items.label: Remind Me Later
items.where: Pro > banner under the title bar (update available)
items.does: Hides the update banner for now.
items.when: You are mid-job.

items.label: IRACING USER ID box
items.where: Pro > top row > iRacing User ID
items.does: Your iRacing customer number (4-7 digits); it is part of the saved file names.
items.when: First setup; paint does not show in iRacing.
items.mistakes: A wrong ID means iRacing ignores the files.
items.help_text: Your iRacing Customer ID (4-7 digits): in iRacing click the helmet icon (top right), then Profile. Not your car number. Required for saving car files.

items.label: CUSTOM NUMBER
items.where: Pro > top row > iRacing User ID
items.does: Custom Number: the number is part of your paint and iRacing will not add one.
items.when: You drew your own number.
items.mistakes: Needs Settings > Graphics > Hide Car Numbers ON in iRacing to load car_num_.

items.label: SIM-STAMPED NUMBER
items.where: Pro > top row > iRacing User ID
items.does: Sim-Stamped Number: iRacing stamps your number on the car in the series font.
items.when: You want iRacing to place the number.
items.mistakes: Do not also paint a number on the template.

items.label: SOURCE PAINT box
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: The paint file Shokker works on (a flat TGA / PNG / JPEG, or a PSD): type or paste a path, or use the buttons beside it.
items.when: Start of every job; "I loaded my paint and nothing happened".
items.mistakes: Pasting a folder path here does not load a paint. A flat TGA has no layers; a PSD does.
items.help_text: Source Paint — disk TGA path, imported/derived source path, or live layered canvas source. Use the folder button for TGA files, or the PSD button for Photoshop layers.

items.label: TGA/PNG/JPEG
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Browse for a flat paint picture (TGA / PNG / JPEG / BMP) and load it as the paint.
items.when: You have a single flat paint file.
items.mistakes: Dropping an image on the canvas also REPLACES the paint; it does not add a logo (use + Layer for that).
items.help_text: Browse Source Paint in Windows File Explorer (TGA, PNG, JPEG, or BMP)

items.label: PSD/XCF/ORA
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Browse for a layered PSD / XCF / ORA template so every layer (body, numbers, sponsors, tape) stays separate.
items.when: You want layer-level control: numbers only, sponsors only.
items.mistakes: Make sure the template layers (Mask, Wire, Car_Mandatory) are OFF before exporting.
items.help_text: Import a layered PSD, XCF, or ORA file with its editable layer tree

items.label: IRACING CAR FOLDER box
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: The iRacing car folder the finished paint and spec files are written to.
items.when: Paint is not showing in iRacing, or choosing which car.
items.mistakes: Point to the car FOLDER, not a TGA file. It sets the file names car_num_ID.tga or car_ID.tga and car_spec_ID.tga.
items.help_text: iRacing Car Folder — point to the exact car paint folder, not a TGA file. Diffuse naming follows the custom-number setting: car_num_XXXXX.tga or car_XXXXX.tga. Spec is car_spec_XXXXX.tga.

items.label: Pick detected iRacing car
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Pick your car from the list of iRacing cars Shokker detected (most recently painted first).
items.when: Faster than browsing for the folder.
items.mistakes: If your car is missing, paint it once in iRacing or browse for the folder.
items.help_text: Pick from your detected iRacing cars (most recently painted first)

items.label: Browse iRacing car folder in Windows File Explorer
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Browse for the iRacing car folder in Windows.
items.when: You cannot find your car in the list.
items.mistakes: Pick the car's own folder inside Documents/iRacing/paint, not a TGA file.

items.label: Make UI chrome smaller
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: shrink toolbar / panel chrome (does NOT zoom the canvas)
items.help_text: UI Smaller — shrink toolbar / panel chrome (does NOT zoom the canvas)

items.label: UI Larger
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: grow toolbar / panel chrome (does NOT zoom the canvas)
items.help_text: UI Larger — grow toolbar / panel chrome (does NOT zoom the canvas)

items.label: PRO
items.where: Any mode > top row > PRO / CHAT pill
items.does: Switch to the full Pro shop.
items.help_text: PRO — the full paint shop: every tool, layers, masks, zones, Spec Sculpt.

items.label: CHAT
items.where: Any mode > top row > PRO / CHAT pill
items.does: Switch to Chat (talk to Shokker).
items.help_text: CHAT — talk to Shokker: say what you want ('retro red white and blue stripes, flat with chrome trim') and watch your car change. Works without any key; an AI key makes it smarter.

items.label: SPEC SCULPT
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Open the complete guided Spec Sculpt look library
items.help_text: Open the complete guided Spec Sculpt look library

items.label: Shokk Drop
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: import art, Import DNA spec, share .spbdrop packs
items.help_text: SHOKK DROP — import art, Import DNA spec, share .spbdrop packs

items.label: Encyclopedia
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: SPB Encyclopedia: how everything in Shokker works - spec maps, zones, finishes, every control. Press / inside to search.
items.help_text: SPB Encyclopedia: how everything in Shokker works - spec maps, zones, finishes, every control. Press / inside to search.

items.label: FRACTURE THIS PAINT
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: One click puts a Soul Core Emerald / Pink Flash finish into the selected zone's base (and its colour unless Color Lock is on).
items.when: A quick dramatic look.
items.mistakes: Changes the zone's colour too unless the Lock is on.
items.help_text: FRACTURE THIS PAINT — one click drops Soul Core Emerald / Pink Flash into this zone's base material (and its base color unless Color Lock is on)

items.label: Settings
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Opens Settings: licence, keyboard shortcuts, ZIP export, spec map import, Live Link, Training Wheels.
items.when: Licence problems, auto-copy to iRacing.
items.help_text: Settings — open settings dropdown (license, auto-deploy, ZIP export)

items.label: Tutorial
items.where: Pro > top of the window (header rows)
items.does: Training Wheels: step-by-step quests that teach the app as you use it (load, zone, finish, render, then patterns, spec, overlays), plus a hint chip for your next move.
items.when: A buyer says "I'm lost" or "what now".
items.mistakes: Toggle it any time; it is also a checkbox in Settings.
items.help_text: Training Wheels — step-by-step quests that teach the full app while you use it: load, zone, finish, render, then patterns, spec, overlays. Toggle any time.

items.label: Licence key box
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) > License
items.does: Enter your Shokker Paint Booth license key (format: SHOKKER-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, 19 characters total)
items.help_text: Enter your Shokker Paint Booth license key (format: SHOKKER-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, 19 characters total)

items.label: Activate
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) > License
items.does: Validate and activate your license key
items.help_text: Validate and activate your license key

items.label: Deactivate
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) > License
items.does: required if you want to use the key on a different machine
items.help_text: Deactivate this license — required if you want to use the key on a different machine

items.label: ZIP export checkbox
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown
items.does: Bundles paint TGA, spec TGA and preview into a ZIP on every render.
items.when: Share or archive.
items.help_text: Bundle paint TGA, spec TGA, and preview into a ZIP on every render

items.label: Training Wheels checkbox
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown
items.does: step-by-step quests and a next-move hint chip that teach the app while you use it
items.help_text: Training Wheels — step-by-step quests and a next-move hint chip that teach the app while you use it

items.label: Keyboard Shortcuts
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown
items.does: Show all keyboard shortcuts (press ?)
items.help_text: Show all keyboard shortcuts (press ?)

items.label: Import TGA
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown
items.does: Import an existing spec map TGA to merge under your render.
items.when: You made a spec map elsewhere.
items.mistakes: Use Clear to go back to the default spec.
items.help_text: Browse for an existing spec map TGA to merge on top of

items.label: Clear
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown
items.does: Remove imported spec map and render on default base
items.help_text: Remove imported spec map and render on default base

items.label: Auto-deploy (Live Link) checkbox
items.where: Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown
items.does: Auto-deploy: copies every render to your iRacing car folder automatically.
items.when: Paint is not reaching iRacing.
items.mistakes: Only matters when the car folder is empty; with a car folder set, files are copied after each render anyway.
items.help_text: Automatically copy rendered files to your iRacing car folder after each render

items.label: Move
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Move tool (V): in Layer mode click a sponsor / number to drag it; Alt forces the whole layer.
items.when: Move or resize a number or logo.
items.mistakes: Switch ZONE / LAYER to LAYER first.
items.help_text: Move (V) — In Layer mode: click a sponsor/number/shape to isolate it for independent move/rotate/scale (tight bbox). Hold Alt to force whole-layer move instead. Outside Layer mode: Ctrl+drag moves the layer.

items.label: Pick
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Pick Item (Y): pick one sponsor / number inside a layer for independent move / rotate.
items.when: Move a single logo on a crowded layer.
items.help_text: Pick Item (Y) — unified per-element picker. Layer: click inside a sponsor layer to get tight bbox + independent move/rotate on just that piece. Zone: hit spec pieces.

items.label: Xform
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Layer mode: selected artwork or selection. Zone mode: current pattern or base.
items.help_text: Transform (Ctrl+T) — Layer mode: selected artwork or selection. Zone mode: current pattern or base.

items.label: Color
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > selection tools
items.does: Color (P): click a colour on the paint to select by it. In Pro zone mode it feeds the selected zone's colour list.
items.when: Select a colour area for a zone.
items.help_text: Pick Color (P) — click a color on the paint to grab it

items.label: Excl
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > selection tools
items.does: paint areas on the car to REMOVE from this zone's color match (red overlay)
items.help_text: Exclude Region — paint areas on the car to REMOVE from this zone's color match (red overlay)

items.label: Wand
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > selection tools
items.does: Magic Wand (W): click to select similar colour; Shift adds, Alt subtracts; Tolerance sets how similar.
items.when: Select an area by colour on the canvas.
items.help_text: Magic Wand (W) — click to sample visible color; Shift adds, Alt subtracts

items.label: Lasso
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > selection tools
items.does: Lasso (L): draw a free-hand selection.
items.when: Select an odd-shaped area.
items.mistakes: Enter closes the shape.
items.help_text: Lasso (L) — drag freehand and release, or click polygon points; Enter closes, Backspace removes the last point

items.label: Rect
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > selection tools
items.does: Rectangle select (O): drag a box selection.
items.when: Select a panel.
items.help_text: Rectangle Select (O) — drag a Zone selection; Shift makes a square, Alt draws from center, Esc cancels

items.label: Brush
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Brush (B): paint the zone's mask, or the selected layer's pixels.
items.when: Hand-draw where a zone applies.
items.mistakes: ZONE mode paints a mask; LAYER mode paints pixels.
items.help_text: Brush (B) — paint the current Zone mask or selected Layer pixels with opacity/hardness

items.label: Fill
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Fill bucket (K): fill a region of the zone mask or the layer.
items.when: Fill a closed area.
items.help_text: Fill Bucket (K) — Layer samples the active layer; Zone samples the composite; Contiguous limits the fill to the clicked area; Layer mode also uses Opacity

items.label: Erase
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Eraser (E): erase zone mask or layer pixels.
items.when: Fix an overpaint.
items.help_text: Eraser (E) — erase the current Zone mask or selected Layer pixels

items.label: History
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: HISTORY menu: Undo, Redo, Undo History.
items.when: Take back changes.

items.label: Undo Ctrl+Z
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Undo the last stroke, transform or layer action (Ctrl+Z).
items.when: Any mistake.
items.help_text: Undo (Ctrl+Z) — undo last stroke, transform, or layer action. Also available via right-click Undo.

items.label: Redo Ctrl+Y
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Redo (Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z).
items.help_text: Redo (Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z) — redo last undone action. Also available via right-click Redo.

items.label: Undo History…
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Opens the recent-actions list so you can jump back several steps.
items.when: Undo more than one step.
items.help_text: Undo History — open recent action list

items.label: Select
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: SELECT menu: Select All Color, Grab Object, Smart Region Fill, Move Selection Border, Pick Layer Element, Zone Pick, Elliptical Marquee.
items.when: Selecting areas or elements.

items.label: Select All Color
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Select All Color (A): select every pixel of the sampled colour across the whole paint.
items.when: Select all of one colour.
items.help_text: Select All Color (A) — click to sample matching pixels across the full visible source; Shift adds, Alt subtracts

items.label: Grab Object
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Grab Object (G): click inside a number or logo and its whole outline is selected.
items.when: Select the numbers on a flat TGA.
items.mistakes: Works best on clear solid shapes.
items.help_text: Grab Object (G) — click inside a solid part of a number or logo to include its outline and shadow. Samples visible paint: hide wire/template guide layers if they split the artwork. Shift adds, Alt subtracts.

items.label: Smart Region Fill
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Smart Region Fill: click inside an edge-bounded area to select it.
items.when: Select a stripe or panel bounded by lines.
items.help_text: Smart Region Fill — click inside an edge-bounded region; Tolerance changes boundary sensitivity, Shift adds, Alt subtracts

items.label: Move Selection Border
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Arrow moves 1px, Shift+Arrow moves 10px; drag inside to move freely; pixels do not move
items.help_text: Move Selection Border — Arrow moves 1px, Shift+Arrow moves 10px; drag inside to move freely; pixels do not move

items.label: Pick Layer Element
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: always force isolation of one sponsor/number/shape inside the layer for its own tight transform box
items.help_text: Pick Item (explicit) — always force isolation of one sponsor/number/shape inside the layer for its own tight transform box

items.label: Zone Pick
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: Zone Pick: click a spec pattern / base piece to move, rotate and resize it independently.
items.when: Adjust one pattern piece.
items.help_text: Zone Pick — click spec patterns / bases / sub-pieces for independent move, rotation and proportional resize (handles, live numbers, snapping).

items.label: Elliptical Marquee
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: drag a Zone selection; Shift makes a circle, Alt draws from center, Esc cancels
items.help_text: Elliptical Marquee (M) — drag a Zone selection; Shift makes a circle, Alt draws from center, Esc cancels

items.label: Retouch
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: RETOUCH menu: Color Brush, Recolor, Healing Brush, Smudge, Burn - pixel retouching on the selected layer.
items.when: Fix or paint artwork.
items.mistakes: Grey until a blank layer exists: use the Add blank for Color Brush button.

items.label: ＋ Add blank for Color Brush
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: Adds a blank layer so the Color Brush has somewhere to paint.
items.when: Color Brush is greyed out.

items.label: Color Brush
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: Color Brush (C): paint solid colour or a pattern brush onto the selected layer.
items.when: Retouch artwork.
items.mistakes: Needs a blank paintable layer (use + Blank layer).
items.help_text: Color Brush (C) — paint solid RGB or the selected Pattern Brush onto the selected Layer

items.label: Recolor
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: Recolor (R): paint a new hue over a sampled colour on the selected layer.
items.when: Recolour a sponsor.
items.help_text: Recolor Tool (R) — on the selected Layer, first click samples source; paint foreground hue/chroma while preserving light and texture

items.label: Healing Brush
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: Alt+click clean texture on the selected Layer, then paint to blend its detail into the target
items.help_text: Healing Brush (Shift+J) — Alt+click clean texture on the selected Layer, then paint to blend its detail into the target

items.label: Smudge
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: smear selected Layer pixels in the drag direction
items.help_text: Smudge Tool (Q) — smear selected Layer pixels in the drag direction

items.label: Burn
items.where: Pro > top toolbar > RETOUCH menu
items.does: darken selected Layer pixels under the brush
items.help_text: Burn (J) — darken selected Layer pixels under the brush

items.label: Mask
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: MASK menu: Grow / Shrink / Fill Holes / Feather / Smooth / Invert / Copy / Mirror a zone's area, plus Include / Exclude Region.
items.when: Clean up where a zone applies.

items.label: ＋ Grow 1 px
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: expand the active Zone selection by one pixel
items.help_text: Grow Selection 1px — expand the active Zone selection by one pixel

items.label: ＋ Grow 2 px
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: add edge safety around an active Zone selection
items.help_text: Grow Selection 2px — add edge safety around an active Zone selection

items.label: Shrink 1 px
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: contract the active Zone selection by one pixel
items.help_text: Shrink Selection 1px — contract the active Zone selection by one pixel

items.label: Shrink 2 px
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: pull the active Zone selection inward
items.help_text: Shrink Selection 2px — pull the active Zone selection inward

items.label: Fill Holes
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: include empty islands fully enclosed by the active selection
items.help_text: Fill Selection Holes — include empty islands fully enclosed by the active selection

items.label: Feather 2 px
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: soften the active Zone selection edge
items.help_text: Feather Selection 2px — soften the active Zone selection edge

items.label: Smooth Edges
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: smooth jagged mask boundaries
items.help_text: Smooth Edges — smooth jagged mask boundaries

items.label: Invert Mask
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: swap selected and unselected areas
items.help_text: Invert Mask — swap selected and unselected areas

items.label: Copy Mask
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: copy this zone's mask to another zone
items.help_text: Copy Mask — copy this zone's mask to another zone

items.label: Mirror Mask
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: flip mask horizontally
items.help_text: Mirror Mask — flip mask horizontally

items.label: Include Region
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: paint areas to keep in zone color match
items.help_text: Include Region — paint areas to keep in zone color match

items.label: Exclude Region
items.where: Pro > top toolbar (tool row)
items.does: paint areas to remove from zone color match
items.help_text: Exclude Region — paint areas to remove from zone color match

items.label: Erase Spatial
